subject: Senior-led intro and pilot gates — BluePeak Analytics
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@bluepeak.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + ask: senior intro to unblock pilot gating

Hi Sanjay — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap while it's fresh: BluePeak's primary goals are to reduce per-query inference cost on heterogeneous GPU fleets and cut tail latency spikes for complex analytics queries. You confirmed a 6–8 week pilot scope targeting two models and a live workload slice.

Key open items we agreed to:
- Executive alignment: a short VP/CTO intro so we can surface SLAs, data governance, and procurement timeline to your execs.
- Technical deep dive: infra, model quantization and caching approach (we'll bring a runbook).
- Mutual action plan (MAP): draft to capture milestones and acceptance criteria.

Can you share who from your side should join the exec intro? Rupa (VP Product) and Tom (CTO) were mentioned — if so, propose a few 30-minute windows next week and we'll lock one. I've attached a one-page MAP draft and a suggested pilot checklist.

Proposed slots (PT):
- Tue 10/12 10:00–10:30
- Tue 10/12 15:00–15:30
- Wed 10/13 09:00–09:30

Attachments: bluepeak-MAP-v1.pdf (PDF), pilot-scope.docx (DOCX)

Thanks — Priyom
Priyom Das
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rupa Shah <rupa@bluepeak.ai>, Tom Lin <tom.lin@bluepeak.ai>
Date: Tue, 06 Oct 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap + ask: senior intro to unblock pilot gating

Thanks, Priyom — useful summary. Rupa and Tom are both on board to do a short alignment call. Rupa prefers mornings PT; Tom is flexible but would like the meeting before EOD Wed.

From our side, availability this week:
- Tue 10/12 10:00am PT — good for Rupa and Tom
- Wed 10/13 08:30am PT — Rupa can't make this one
- Wed 10/13 11:00am PT — Tom can make this

If Tue 10/12 10:00 works for Redwood, let's lock that. Also, happy to review the MAP ahead of time — I'll ask our procurement lead to glance at the milestones.

Best,
Sanjay Rao
Head of Data Products | BluePeak Analytics
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 06 Oct 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: prep for exec touch and runbook owner

Quick note — external confirmed Tue 10/12 10:00am PT as preferred. Karthik, can you lead the 15–20 minute technical portion and be prepared to speak high-level on:
- expected end-to-end latency improvements (90th/95th percentiles)
- quantization tradeoffs and observable impact to accuracy
- our proposed fallback routing and caching approach for BluePeak's mixed batch/interactive workload

I've attached the infra runbook for your reference. Marissa, will you own the MAP review and contracting runway? I can invite procurement later this week if needed.

Attachments: infra-runbook-v2.pdf

Thanks — Priyom
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>

Hi all — thanks Sanjay, Priyom. Confirming Tue 10/12 10:00am PT works for Redwood (I've blocked the slot and sent a calendar hold). I'll keep the exec segment tight (10 minutes intro, 15 minutes Q&A) and then we can follow with a 45-minute tech run-through with your infra team later in the week if you'd like.

What I'll cover in the exec segment:
- concrete success criteria we expect to validate during the 6–8 week pilot
- high-level perf expectations and fallback behavior
- what we'll need access to (s3/path to sample traffic, model checkpoints, and a short list of queries)

I've uploaded the pilot scope doc and runbook to the shared Drive folder and included the calendar link below.
